source: Yardbarker: IndyCar

title: Quiet finish to Dixon’s epic Ganassi tenure
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: The last race of Scott Dixon’s farewell season with Chip Ganassi Racing ended in a similar fashion to the first race of 2026. title: IndyCar legends unite to launch Zanardi Corkscrew era at Laguna Seca
source: All IndyCar, USF Pro Champinships and IndyNext Articles | RACER
excerpt: Thirty years ago at Turn 8, which is better known as the Corkscrew – named for its curling and winding pathway that plunges down the hill – Alex Zanardi executed “The Pass” on Bryan Herta to earn the win at the 1996 CART IndyCar Series season finale. On its 30th anniversary, the renowned corner was renamed in the Italian’s honor with IndyCar luminaries on hand and on track.

title: Alex Palou clinches 5th IndyCar title; Pato O'Ward sweeps Milwaukee twin bill
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: Pato O'Ward had a day for the record book -- something Alex Palou knows all about. While O'Ward won two IndyCar races in one day at the Milwaukee Mile, Palou did enough to clinch a historic IndyCar Series championship with one week to go Sunday in West Allis, Wis.

title: Pato O'Ward wins Milwaukee Mile 250 with postponed race still on tap
source: Yardbarker: IndyCar
excerpt: Pato O'Ward claimed his second victory of the season Sunday by edging Scott McLaughlin at the Snap-on Milwaukee Mile 250 in West Allis, Wis. The native of Mexico is in a rare position to win two races in one day after Saturday's Snap-on Makers and Fixers 250 was interrupted by heavy rain and postponed to a Sunday finish.
